input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: This hosting agreement contains no exit mechanics. Section 14 (Termination) only sets the run-off date for Hosting and Support Services, and Section 13 merely makes Client responsible for arranging a new name server and hosting environment (30/60 days) and confirms Client retains ownership of its domains and Client Content — it imposes no TrueLink obligation to provide transition assistance, to return or export Client data, or to delete it. Section 10 (Confidentiality) contains no return-or-destroy obligation, and the survival clause (Section 24) adds nothing on exit. Nothing anywhere addresses data return, export format, or certified deletion, so the rule's clause is absent and we insert a short preferred-level transition and data-return provision after Section 14.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.

proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance and data return clause after Section 14 (Termination)
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no exit mechanics, so we add a short transition clause: on any expiry or termination TrueLink provides up to six months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, returns our data within 30 days in a standard machine-readable format, and certifies deletion after that return. We can fall back to 90 days of assistance with a 30-day export if six months is unworkable.

ops.text: TRANSITION ASSISTANCE AND DATA RETURN. Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, TrueLink shall (a) at Client's request, provide transition assistance for up to six (6) months following such expiry or termination, at TrueLink's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days after such expiry or termination, return to Client all data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Client in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) after such return, delete all such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Client in writing.
